general_information.Description: This beginner English foundation course provides beginner learners with essential English skills for everyday communication. It focuses on developing basic vocabulary, grammar, and pronunciation for real-life situations such as greetings, daily routines, and personal information. Students practice listening, speaking, reading, and writing through interactive and contextualized tasks. The course also fosters the ability to use technology and AI tools to support language learning, encourages collaboration and responsibility, and promotes self-assessment for continuous improvement and lifelong learning in a global context.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfil tasks given by instructors after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purposes - Use the CD-ROM provided with the textbook - Access the course website for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online support from teachers and other students, and for practicing and assessment.
general_information.Note: 1) On-going assessment: 50% 2) Final Examination: 50% 3) Final results: 100% 4) Completion Criteria: Each part of the final exam must be >0, Final Result >=5 & Final Exam Score >=4.

description: This beginner English foundation course provides beginner learners with essential English skills for everyday communication. It focuses on developing basic vocabulary, grammar, and pronunciation for real-life situations such as greetings, daily routines, and personal information. Students practice listening, speaking, reading, and writing through interactive and contextualized tasks. The course also fosters the ability to use technology and AI tools to support language learning, encourages collaboration and responsibility, and promotes self-assessment for continuous improvement and lifelong learning in a global context.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Identify English vocabulary, grammar structures, and pronunciation features used in everyday communication.
Apply basic English expressions, sentence patterns, and cultural norms appropriately in common social situations.
Comprehend main ideas and key details in short, clear, and slow-paced spoken texts or conversations on familiar everyday topics.
Deliver short spoken exchanges or presentations on familiar topics using simple vocabulary, clear pronunciation, and correct basic structures.
Read and extract key information from short texts, forms, and authentic materials related to daily life and work situations.

Write simple phrases and sentences about familiar topics (e.g., family, routines, daily activities); produce a short paragraph with understandable meaning, basic organization, and accurate spelling and grammar.
Apply information technology and artificial intelligence (AI) tools to enhance English learning efficiently, ethically, and responsibly.
Work independently and collaboratively with responsibility, demonstrating respect, professionalism, and ethical behavior in communication and academic activities.
Develop a personal learning plan using self-assessment and technology to monitor progress, reflect on performance, and improve English proficiency for lifelong learning and global communication.
